slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that make real life
more fun than your phone

film photography

buy a cheap film camera and take one roll of photos a month. waiting to see your pictures makes every shot count, and you start looking at the world more closely.

learning in small doses

learn one fascinating thing a day: a myth, a planet, a famous painting. real curiosity is so much more satisfying than another hour of scrolling past strangers.
slides.texte_sophia:
learning in small doses

i used to scroll for hours every night. now i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, a myth or a planet, and i don't even miss the endless feed anymore.

slides.texte_overlay:
bouldering

try a bouldering gym once a week. each wall is a little puzzle for your body, and you're far too busy thinking about your next move to even remember your phone.

cooking for friends

invite friends over and cook one new recipe together. a messy kitchen full of laughter beats any video of someone else cooking, and the food is even better.

night walks

take a slow walk after dinner without headphones. evening streets, warm windows and cool air are a gentle, quiet reset that no screen will ever really give you.
